Opt. Soc. Am. 63, 763, DOI 10.1364/JOSA.63.000763; closed; read from the journal's page, https://opg.optica.org/josa/abstract.cfm?uri=josa-63-6-763, SHA-256 57b67350aaf9eb76b85c3b77ed914480a2c05484fa91c21fc991ff15bd56778a, fetched 2026-10-15, which gives no abstract) lists a Lambert absorption coefficient of 0.285 cm⁻¹ at 370 nm, 0.212 at 400, 0.139 at 455, 0.054 at 654, 0.034 at 714, 0.178 at 800 and 0.027 at 847 nm, Napierian per cm, T = exp(−αx) (D. Its rise into the blue is not ammonia's: the intense bands begin below about 240 nm, and the shortest band Jolly lists for the pure liquid is a weak one at 0.802 µm (W. L.
